name: process that results in running coupling α(Q²)

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Landau pole and the Planck scale cutoff
phase_0.domain_name: process that results in running coupling α(Q²)
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: The forward progression toward higher energy scales and shorter distances

AREV.justification: The movement toward lower energy scales where screening effects dominate

CLINK.justification: The sequential composition of infinitesimal changes in coupling over a range of scales

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous existence of the coupling as both a fixed value and a dynamic function

EVALF.justification: The negative state where coupling increases as energy increases (Abelian/QED)

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where coupling decreases as energy increases (non-Abelian)

FFUSE.justification: The recombination of virtual fluctuations into a single effective interaction vertex

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of the field into virtual particle-antiparticle pairs

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of the coupling constant at a specific reference scale like M_Z

IMSCRIB.justification: The underlying identity of the theory that remains constant across all scales

TANCH.justification: The final measurable strength of the interaction at a specific energy scale

VINIT.justification: The unshielded, unobservable point-like source before vacuum polarization occurs

phase_3.both_description: The full trajectory of the running coupling across all energy regimes
phase_3.false_description: The infrared limit where the interaction becomes non-perturbative and strong
phase_3.true_description: The ultraviolet limit where the interaction becomes perturbative and weak
phase_3.void_description: The bare Lagrangian parameters before the inclusion of loop corrections

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The exchange of virtual gauge bosons between matter fields
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The running coupling constant acting as the state of the field strength
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The energy scale Q determining which fluctuations are resolved
